Mona collaborates with some of the world's most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long-lasting, and cruelty-free. Each luxurious fragrance is an ode to true craftsmanship and tells a special story, from the addictive notes to the multi-faceted jeweled bottles.

Our Mission

To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent and by providing them with the most innovative & luxurious fragrances, education and sharing our Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.

About the Role

FundingPips is looking for a Senior Brand Designer / Design Lead to lead the visual direction of FundingPips, manage the quality and development of our design team, and build new brands and visual identities from the ground up.
This is not simply an executional design role.
We are looking for someone who can take a business idea, product or brand with no existing visual identity and transform it into a complete, commercially relevant brand system — from initial creative direction and visual territory through to identity, typography, colour systems, graphic language, guidelines and rollout.
The role also requires a strong understanding of e-commerce and conversion-focused design. The successful candidate should understand how creative decisions influence customer behaviour across landing pages, product pages, checkout journeys, promotional campaigns and paid advertising.
Alongside developing new brands, this person will own and evolve the FundingPips visual identity, ensuring everything we produce is distinctive, consistent and commercially effective.
The role requires someone equally comfortable thinking strategically, directing other designers and remaining hands-on when required.

Key Responsibilities:

Brand Creation & Development

Develop complete brands and visual identities from scratch.
Translate business strategy, audience positioning and brand personality into a clear visual direction.
Conduct visual research, competitor analysis and category mapping before developing new identities.
Develop moodboards, visual territories and creative concepts during the early stages of brand development.
Create complete identity systems including:

Logos and brand marks
Typography systems
Colour palettes
Graphic language
Iconography
Image and photography direction
Illustration styles
Motion principles
Social media identity
Digital design systems
Build comprehensive brand guidelines that allow internal and external teams to consistently execute the identity.
Develop scalable design systems that can work across digital, social, advertising, product, events and offline environments.
Lead the rollout of new brands from initial concept through to launch.
Ensure new brands have their own identity while remaining strategically appropriate within the wider company or group portfolio.

Brand & Creative Direction

Own and continuously evolve the FundingPips visual identity.
Translate marketing strategies and campaign concepts into strong visual directions.
Develop campaign identities rather than treating individual assets as isolated designs.
Maintain consistency across social media, website, email, advertising, events, affiliates, partnerships and product marketing.
Build and maintain scalable brand guidelines, visual systems, templates and design libraries.
Protect brand quality while continuously pushing the visual identity forward.
Identify opportunities to make FundingPips more distinctive, culturally relevant and recognisable within the trading industry.

E-Commerce & Conversion-Focused Design

Apply strong e-commerce and conversion-rate optimisation principles across customer-facing creative.
Design with both brand impact and commercial performance in mind.
Understand how visual hierarchy, messaging, layout, colour, trust signals and calls-to-action influence customer behaviour.
Collaborate with Growth, Performance Marketing, Content and Product teams to improve conversion across:

Landing pages
Product and pricing pages
Promotional pages
Checkout journeys
Campaign pages
Email campaigns
Paid advertising
Develop clear visual journeys that guide users toward key actions such as product selection, registration and purchase.
Ensure promotional offers, pricing, discounts, product benefits and key USPs are communicated clearly and effectively.
Create and oversee creative variations for A/B testing and conversion experiments.
Analyse creative performance data including CTR, conversion rate, engagement and other relevant metrics to improve future design decisions.
Work closely with Performance Marketing to identify which creative formats, messaging hierarchies and visual approaches drive stronger acquisition.
Balance urgency and promotional messaging with long-term brand credibility.
Identify and reduce visual friction within customer purchase journeys.
Ensure mobile-first design principles are considered across high-conversion pages and campaign assets.
Understand how design contributes not only to awareness but to revenue, customer acquisition and retention.

Design Team Leadership

Lead the FundingPips design team and establish a high creative standard across the department.
Provide creative direction to graphic, motion and digital designers.
Review work before publication and provide clear, actionable feedback.
Mentor designers and support their technical and creative development.
Assign and prioritise design work alongside Content and Marketing leadership.
Establish design workflows, quality-control processes and best practices.
Ensure designers understand the strategy and objective behind their work rather than simply executing briefs.
Develop commercial awareness within the design team, ensuring designers understand how their work contributes to marketing and business performance.
Improve creative efficiency without reducing quality.
Support hiring decisions and identify capability gaps within the design team.

Campaign Development

Partner with Content and Marketing leadership from the earliest stages of campaign development.
Create visual concepts for product launches, promotions, competitions, giveaways and major brand campaigns.
Develop key visuals that can scale across multiple channels and formats.
Ensure campaign identities translate effectively across organic social, paid media, video, email, web and offline activations.
Build campaign creative around clear messaging hierarchy, product USPs and customer actions.
Collaborate closely with videographers, editors, content creators, motion designers and copywriters to create cohesive campaigns.
Consider both brand objectives and conversion objectives when developing campaign creative.

Digital & Social

Maintain a strong understanding of modern digital and social-first design.
Lead creative direction across Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, Discord and other digital channels.
Understand how visual design contributes to attention, engagement, conversion and brand perception.
Collaborate with Performance Marketing on advertising creatives and creative testing.
Develop variations and iterations based on performance rather than treating creative as a one-time deliverable.
Use performance insights and audience behaviour to inform future creative direction.

Introduce new visual formats and creative approaches instead of relying exclusively on existing templates.

About Wego

Wego is a travel marketplace built in the Middle East and Asia. Millions of travellers use the Wego website and app to search, compare and book flights and hotels, either with our airline, hotel and travel-site partners or directly on Wego.

We are a technology company first. Teams are small, autonomy is high, approval chains are short, and AI is part of how every team works, from pricing to marketing.

Job Purpose

The Head of Brand Growth owns how Wego wins travellers before they search, and makes that growth measurable. You will own the Wego brand, social, and our creator and influencer programme, with your own budget and your own numbers. You will run them as a growth engine, judged on demand, conversion and repeat bookings, not on awareness and impressions alone.

This is a hands-on, experimental role inside a growth-led marketing team. You will work hand in hand with performance marketing, who buy your campaigns against the KPIs you set, and you will judge every brand and social activity by what it does further down the funnel. Our brand channels are already digital and addressable, so you will spend your time in the platforms and in the data, not in decks.

Key Responsibilities

Brand growth strategy
Own Wego's positioning, messaging, tone of voice and brand guidelines across our markets, including our brand character, Weegio.
Decide each quarter which audience segments and markets to grow, using our brand tracking, customer segmentation and competitive data.
Find what moves travellers from knowing Wego to considering us to booking with us, and build the plan around it.
Own the campaign calendar: seasonal tentpoles such as Ramadan, Eid, summer and national days, plus always-on activity.
Social and community
Lead the social team across Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, X and YouTube Shorts. The team makes its own content at platform speed.
Test formats, hooks and creative fast, then scale what drives traffic, installs and bookings.
Run community and social care as proof that Wego delivers: fast replies, visible problem-solving and a voice travellers trust.
Turn travellers' trips into stories through user-generated content and creator stays.
Creators and influencers
Run the creator and influencer programme as a growth channel: selection on audience fit, contracts, briefs, usage and whitelisting rights.
Judge creators on what they drive, such as cost per engaged view, traffic, installs and bookings, not on follower counts.
Work with the performance media team to amplify the creator content that converts.
Full-funnel growth with performance marketing
Own the brand budget line: reach and engagement media, creators and brand research.
Brief reach and engagement campaigns to Wego's performance media team, who buy and optimise them against the KPIs you set. One media desk serves all of marketing, and the budget and the targets stay yours.
Design brand-to-conversion journeys with performance, organic and CRM: engaged audiences that feed retargeting, landing pages that convert, and offers that bring travellers back.
Track how brand activity shows up in branded search, direct and app traffic, conversion rates and acquisition costs.
Experimentation and measurement
Run a constant test-and-learn programme across creative, formats, audiences, markets and offers.
Commit to a baseline and targets, and report against them in a written quarterly plan covering objectives, hypotheses, budget ask and committed numbers.
Prove causation, not just correlation: design market holdout tests on reach campaigns with our data team, and use platform lift studies where scale allows.
Make every brand and social number computable: listening, campaign tagging, and platform data flowing into our analytics.
An AI-first function
Run brand and social on AI: Claude as the day-to-day workhorse, platform connectors for actions, shared working folders for context, and Looker for every number.
Build and improve agents for the repeatable work, such as segment briefs, social listening, community reply drafts, creator shortlists and weekly reporting. Keep human quality gates on brand character, culture and Arabic.
Working across Wego
Work with the in-house creative studio, which serves brand within a fixed quarterly capacity share and crafts hero campaigns and the template system.
Work with organic and search on long-form YouTube and search content that carries brand stories.
Work with martech and data on tracking and measurement, and with product and customer operations so brand promises are true before they are made.

Experience

Qualifications & Experience

5 to 8 years in brand, social or growth marketing at a consumer technology, travel, e-commerce or high-frequency app business.
Experience working in a growth function, or closely with performance marketing, with KPIs that ran down to conversion: traffic, installs, bookings and acquisition cost, not only reach and impressions.
A track record of brand and social work that drove measurable growth, and of being held to the numbers.
Experience leading a small team and owning a budget across channels and markets.

Digital, data and performance

Digital native, with deep, current, hands-on knowledge of Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube, including how paid works: formats, bidding, frequency and optimisation.
You understand how performance marketing works, including attribution, retargeting, CPA and ROAS, and where brand fits in the funnel.
Data-driven and comfortable in the numbers. You know testing and measurement: A/B tests, lift and holdout tests, and marketing mix modelling concepts. Experience with Looker, Tableau or an equivalent BI tool; SQL is an advantage.

AI literacy

You already build with AI in your own work: research, production, analysis and workflow.
Experience with Claude or other generative AI platforms, and with automating marketing work, is a strong advantage.

Market knowledge

You know the MENA consumer and its platforms: what works and what doesn't, culturally and creatively.
Experience in South Asia or Southeast Asia is a plus. Arabic language skills are an advantage.

How You Work

Self-directed. You arrive with your own objectives, strategy and numbers.
Scrappy, hands-on and experimental. You would rather run ten tests and scale the two that work than perfect one campaign, and you still make things yourself.
Full-funnel. You think from the first impression to the booking, and on to the repeat booking.
Research- and numbers-led, with strong creative judgement.
A clear communicator who leads through others, across teams and without formal authority.

Nice to have

Travel, marketplace or multi-market consumer app experience.
Experience building a brand around a mascot or brand character.

Briefly about ourselves

Random is an experience design studio based in Amsterdam and Paris. Our work comes to life where the digital and the physical are fluid. We use technology in a human, tangible way and so invite people to connect to each other and the space they share.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Creative Lead who starts with the big question.

Before the space, before the technology, before any of it: what is this experience actually saying? What does this brand need to communicate, and what's the most compelling way to do that in a room, at an event, in a space someone walks into?

That's where this role begins. With a holistic communication concept a brand storytelling idea that gives a project its reason for being. From there, it translates into spatial decisions, interactive moments, technology choices. But those come second. The person we're looking for holds the full arc, from the strategic question down to the specific expression of it.

We would like you to think from brand strategy to communication to experiential execution. In practice, that means someone like this might challenge a client's underlying ambition, build a creative communication strategy for a launch, and define a high-level concept for how a space should behave all within the same project.

If your strongest work is brand campaign films or advertising concepts, this isn't the right role. If your interest lies in creating (spatial) brand experiences where you make people feel something, invite them to explore, make them wonder, then please read on.

Core responsibilities

Concept development: Lead the creative thinking on key projects from brief to concept. Write clear, strong debriefs that sharpen the question before anyone starts answering it. Develop brand storytelling ideas that are holistic not just a visual style, or just a content format, but an idea about what a brand experience should do and feel like and mean.

Creative direction across projects Translate concepts into creative direction for multi-disciplinary teams, spatial designers, creative technologists, motion designers, producers. Not by designing everything yourself, but by making sure the idea holds across every decision.

Client relationships Be the main creative voice with clients throughout a project. Present with clarity and conviction. Challenge briefs when they need challenging. Help clients understand the difference between an installation and an experience.

Team leadership Build and lead project teams, internal and freelance. Set creative standards, give useful feedback, create space for others to do good work. Lead by being present, specific and engaged —not a distant creative director.

New business contribution Contribute to pitches and proposals. Bring ideas to the table early in the process, when the thinking matters most.

What a concept means for us

We've learned to be specific about this because the word gets used to mean too many things.

A Concept In This Context Is Not

A sketch or a render
A visual identity direction
A campaign format or content type
A technology idea

A concept is a brand storytelling idea. It's the answer to the question: what is this experience about? The why. It can usually be expressed in a sentence or two. It generates decisions — about space, interaction, content, materiality, technology — rather than describing them.

The technology is a tool. The space is a medium. The concept is the reason any of it exists.

Your profile

8+ years of experience in creative roles within experiential, brand, or spatial work
A portfolio of idea-led projects where you can clearly articulate what the concept was, where it came from, and how it shaped the final work
Experience working across disciplines: spatial, digital, interactive, content
Comfortable at the strategic level able to read and challenge a brand brief, not just respond to it
Strong presenter and communicator, in rooms that matter
Experience leading teams and working with freelancers
Has worked with global brands in lifestyle, fashion, luxury, or sport
Based in or willing to relocate to Amsterdam or Paris

What we don't need more of

We've had talented people apply whose work is genuinely strong but in a different domain. To save everyone time:

This role is not well suited to people whose primary experience is in advertising, brand film, or content production. The thinking that makes someone good at a 30-second spot or a social campaign is different from what this role requires. Neither is better, they're just different.

What's missing, and what we're looking for, is someone who starts with an idea.

What success looks like

You bring a clear concept to every project, early one that the whole team can work from
Clients trust your creative judgment, not just your execution
The work feels like it has a point of view, not just a visual language
Teams you lead know what they're aiming at and why
You make the projects harder in the right ways, and easier in the wrong ones

Random Studio Diversity & Inclusion Statement

At Random Studio, we believe that an inclusive work environment and a diverse team are key to creating fresh and inspiring work. We’re looking for candidates who enrich our culture and challenge the status quo. We encourage everyone to bring their whole selves to work, and we strive to provide all candidates with an unbiased and accessible recruitment process. If you require assistance due to a disability when applying please let us know in your application so we can accommodate your needs.

new_jobs.description:
About Wego

Wego is a travel marketplace built in the Middle East and Asia. Millions of travellers use the Wego website and app to search, compare and book flights and hotels, either with our airline, hotel and travel-site partners or directly on Wego.

We are a technology company first. Teams are small, autonomy is high, approval chains are short, and AI is part of how every team works, from pricing to marketing.

Job Purpose

The Head of Brand Growth owns how Wego wins travellers before they search, and makes that growth measurable. You will own the Wego brand, social, and our creator and influencer programme, with your own budget and your own numbers. You will run them as a growth engine, judged on demand, conversion and repeat bookings, not on awareness and impressions alone.

This is a hands-on, experimental role inside a growth-led marketing team. You will work hand in hand with performance marketing, who buy your campaigns against the KPIs you set, and you will judge every brand and social activity by what it does further down the funnel. Our brand channels are already digital and addressable, so you will spend your time in the platforms and in the data, not in decks.

Key Responsibilities

Brand growth strategy
Own Wego's positioning, messaging, tone of voice and brand guidelines across our markets, including our brand character, Weegio.
Decide each quarter which audience segments and markets to grow, using our brand tracking, customer segmentation and competitive data.
Find what moves travellers from knowing Wego to considering us to booking with us, and build the plan around it.
Own the campaign calendar: seasonal tentpoles such as Ramadan, Eid, summer and national days, plus always-on activity.
Social and community
Lead the social team across Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, X and YouTube Shorts. The team makes its own content at platform speed.
Test formats, hooks and creative fast, then scale what drives traffic, installs and bookings.
Run community and social care as proof that Wego delivers: fast replies, visible problem-solving and a voice travellers trust.
Turn travellers' trips into stories through user-generated content and creator stays.
Creators and influencers
Run the creator and influencer programme as a growth channel: selection on audience fit, contracts, briefs, usage and whitelisting rights.
Judge creators on what they drive, such as cost per engaged view, traffic, installs and bookings, not on follower counts.
Work with the performance media team to amplify the creator content that converts.
Full-funnel growth with performance marketing
Own the brand budget line: reach and engagement media, creators and brand research.
Brief reach and engagement campaigns to Wego's performance media team, who buy and optimise them against the KPIs you set. One media desk serves all of marketing, and the budget and the targets stay yours.
Design brand-to-conversion journeys with performance, organic and CRM: engaged audiences that feed retargeting, landing pages that convert, and offers that bring travellers back.
Track how brand activity shows up in branded search, direct and app traffic, conversion rates and acquisition costs.
Experimentation and measurement
Run a constant test-and-learn programme across creative, formats, audiences, markets and offers.
Commit to a baseline and targets, and report against them in a written quarterly plan covering objectives, hypotheses, budget ask and committed numbers.
Prove causation, not just correlation: design market holdout tests on reach campaigns with our data team, and use platform lift studies where scale allows.
Make every brand and social number computable: listening, campaign tagging, and platform data flowing into our analytics.
An AI-first function
Run brand and social on AI: Claude as the day-to-day workhorse, platform connectors for actions, shared working folders for context, and Looker for every number.
Build and improve agents for the repeatable work, such as segment briefs, social listening, community reply drafts, creator shortlists and weekly reporting. Keep human quality gates on brand character, culture and Arabic.
Working across Wego
Work with the in-house creative studio, which serves brand within a fixed quarterly capacity share and crafts hero campaigns and the template system.
Work with organic and search on long-form YouTube and search content that carries brand stories.
Work with martech and data on tracking and measurement, and with product and customer operations so brand promises are true before they are made.

Experience

Qualifications & Experience

5 to 8 years in brand, social or growth marketing at a consumer technology, travel, e-commerce or high-frequency app business.
Experience working in a growth function, or closely with performance marketing, with KPIs that ran down to conversion: traffic, installs, bookings and acquisition cost, not only reach and impressions.
A track record of brand and social work that drove measurable growth, and of being held to the numbers.
Experience leading a small team and owning a budget across channels and markets.

Digital, data and performance

Digital native, with deep, current, hands-on knowledge of Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube, including how paid works: formats, bidding, frequency and optimisation.
You understand how performance marketing works, including attribution, retargeting, CPA and ROAS, and where brand fits in the funnel.
Data-driven and comfortable in the numbers. You know testing and measurement: A/B tests, lift and holdout tests, and marketing mix modelling concepts. Experience with Looker, Tableau or an equivalent BI tool; SQL is an advantage.

AI literacy

You already build with AI in your own work: research, production, analysis and workflow.
Experience with Claude or other generative AI platforms, and with automating marketing work, is a strong advantage.

Market knowledge

You know the MENA consumer and its platforms: what works and what doesn't, culturally and creatively.
Experience in South Asia or Southeast Asia is a plus. Arabic language skills are an advantage.

How You Work

Self-directed. You arrive with your own objectives, strategy and numbers.
Scrappy, hands-on and experimental. You would rather run ten tests and scale the two that work than perfect one campaign, and you still make things yourself.
Full-funnel. You think from the first impression to the booking, and on to the repeat booking.
Research- and numbers-led, with strong creative judgement.
A clear communicator who leads through others, across teams and without formal authority.

Nice to have

Travel, marketplace or multi-market consumer app experience.
Experience building a brand around a mascot or brand character.

new_jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Be part of a bold new chapter in content creation through a ground-breaking collaboration between M&S and The Production Factory. Together, we’re launching a dynamic new creative hub at the iconic Big Sky Studios – a purpose-built space to spark imagination, foster creativity and deliver excellence. This is more than a job; it’s a rare opportunity to help shape the visual identity of one of Britain’s best-loved brands.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Lead Creative Producer at Production Factory, you will be a key member of the production team, reporting to the Senior Creative Producer. You will play an essential role in producing world-class brand content for M&S digital platforms and e-commerce. You will have a good understanding of the nuances of creative across photography, video and post-production. You will be responsible for ensuring that all teams are scheduled for weekly shoots and content is aligned with the brand’s creative vision/guidelines and delivered on time and within budget.

This role combines creative project management with production oversight, requiring a deep understanding of the workflows and timelines involved in producing high-quality brand assets, from concept to final delivery, including art direction, photography, video, retouching, editing, audio, animation, and grading. You will be expected to manage weekly planning, collaborate with internal and external teams, and ensure that all creative elements come together seamlessly.

Please note: due to the nature of our business, this role is studio-based 5 days per week.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

·      Collaborate with M&S, internal teams and freelancers (art directors, stylists, photographers, DOPs, HMUA, retouchers, editors, etc.) to ensure content is delivered efficiently and meets brand and business goals across all platforms.
·      With support from the Senior Creative Producer, manage end-to-end planning for weekly shoots, ensuring alignment with M&S sample delivery and creative direction from the brand's creative & styling teams.
·      Direct Line management of PA team.
·      Meticulously manage the full life-cycle of the content creation process for your shoots; from delivery of samples > product shoots > colour matching in retouch > model shoots > post-production> final delivery of assets. Ensure the smooth handover of assets from post-production to M&S team before closing a project and reconciling.
·      Receive shoot forecast from M&S and keep studio teams and freelancers updated.
·      Create and manage project plans, production schedules, call sheets, coordinating the full creative shoot process from initial brief to final delivery. This includes ensuring that all elements—such as imagery, video and associated post-production are managed effectively, within timelines, and project status is communicated clearly/regularly across teams.
·      Work closely with Creative Services Manager on styling support for digital shoots.
·      Work closely with the casting manager, stylists and art directors, along with the M&S team to ensure appropriate models are available and booked for shoots.
·      Lead weekly planning and status meetings with clients
·      Support Senior Creative Producer with special projects.
·      Ensure shoots are correctly resourced, teams are on-set when required and looked after during shoots. Co-ordinate bookings for freelancers; models, stylists, photographers and hair & make-up artists, along with their travel, accommodation (if necessary) and catering arrangements.
·      Always maintain financial control while ensuring best-in-class output. Support Senior Creative Producer with tracking spend, negotiate supplier and model rates in line with approved rate card to ensure shoots remain within budget for M&S.
·      Oversee administrative tasks related to shoots for PA’s and Creative Producers, including processing invoices, issuing POs, updating the financial tracker, and ensuring all necessary documents (e.g., booking forms/contracts/call sheets/travel) are in place for freelancers and models.
·      Manage shoot day logistics on-site, providing on-set coordination to keep production running smoothly and on schedule to ensure shoot targets are met.
·      Run shoot status reports to ensure projects are on track and all information is up to date and easily accessible by relevant stakeholders.
·      Ensure the studio environment is kept tidy, safe, and well-managed, supporting the Senior Creative Producer, Ops & HR teams to manage health and safety policies during shoots.
·      Stay up-to-date on trends and best practices in creative production, bringing fresh ideas to the team to stay ahead of the curve.
·      Be available to work for blocks of days associated with the scheduled shoots to deliver the seasonal collection in time for product launch.

SKILLS

·      You are the Senior Creative Producer’s right-hand person. A trusted Lead for the Production team to learn from. Setting the example for excellent production and client management.
·      You are an experienced Lead Creative Producer with a background in fashion and home retail. Beauty, food and jewellery a plus!
·      Have 2 years of management experience and history supporting growth within a business.
·      Multi-skilled, with a strong understanding of the end-to-end creative process within a content studio setting, working across still life and model content; including photography, video production and post-production (retouching, editing, audio, animation, grading), and the ability to manage all aspects of creative content creation.
·      Skilled at creating complex project plans that integrate various creative processes, with a focus on managing timelines and coordinating teams across different production stages.
·      A strong communicator, capable of supporting cross-functional teams and aligning them on creative briefs, production timelines, and goals.
·      A proficient negotiator, able to manage budgets effectively and secure the best talent, suppliers, and creative resources without compromising on quality.
·      Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
·      An industry-savvy problem solver, capable of adapting to change, overcoming challenges, and finding solutions that support the successful execution of creative projects.
